explication: Google Fonts Files is a repository of distributable font binaries plus family metadata, designer information, axis definitions, language-support data, and typography documentation. The principal workflow is a font consumer reading a family’s files and metadata, optionally using language and axis information to select or process fonts. The sampled code shows Python and Rust APIs for axis data and Rust/Python language-data access; unsampled serving infrastructure is not represented. Build and test machinery is intentionally omitted.
